stance_rationale: Forge has real walk-forward artifacts, but production admission is not defensible because official Forge outputs breach turnover, max_names, and final-date sum-of-weights constraints while DSR/Harvey 5-spec and full pure-function hash proof are missing.

critical_concerns.description: Official Forge comparison_table.csv reports S3 Annualized_Turnover=138.141176 ratio, i.e. 13,814% annualized, versus the hard <600% mandate; forge_package_draft instead quotes optimizer turnover 5.7619 and omits this official Forge failure.

Expanded S3 holdings violate absolute sum-of-weights on 2026-05-01: output/S3_Hybrid_70_15_15/04_holdings.csv sums to 0.85 after dropping the TSMOM ETF leg, while forge_package_draft claims sum_w_eq_1=true and sum_w_max_dev=0.

Global max_names remains breached in Forge outputs: S3 max unique tickers per date is 29, Avg_N_Holdings is 26.23438, and deploy nonzero unique tickers are 27. Deferring this as stock-sleeve-only while marking production_grade=true is not a hard-constraint pass.
No DSR penalty and no Harvey 5-spec regressions are supplied: CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, FF6 t_NW/alpha_monthly/DSR outputs are absent, and the same DSR penalty is not applied to S0 baseline.

Pure Function v6.1 R12 audit is incomplete: forge_package_draft hashes risk_package, optimization_package, and weights.csv, but omits alpha_package start/end md5, so the required 3-package hash proof is not established.
Cost/return contract evidence is internally inconsistent: S3 2005-02 has ret_gross=0, ret_net=0.06838442, and cost_ret=-0.06838442, an impossible negative cost row that audit algebra does not catch.

Artifact lineage remains path-inconsistent: the user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-P20260505_001 alpha_scores/covariance paths do not exist; actual covariance is under root stage_artifacts, and STR_1715 alpha_scores are inherited from stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv itself has 256 as_of_dates from 2005-02-01 to 2026-05-01 and sums to 1 per date.
STR_1715 expanded holdings are time-varying across 256 dates with 439 unique tickers, so the specific single-snapshot Iter 4 RF-A7 pattern is not the primary failure.
stage_artifacts/WT_P20260505_001/covariance.parquet is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.001966966 and condition number 22.85608, below the 100 threshold.
annual_returns.png and oos_zoom_chart.png are present; post-2024 strategy lines are visible, although no lockbox marker is shown.
unresolved_disputes: Whether max_names=20 is global book or stock-sleeve-only remains unresolved; base hard constraints read as global.
Whether monthly_returns.parquet can be replaced by 03_period_returns.csv is undocumented.
Whether inherited promotion status waives DSR and Harvey 5-spec gates is undocumented.
Whether the missing 2026-05 TSMOM holdings are a final-row display issue or an actual backtest/contract defect is unresolved.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that Forge can mark this production_grade while its own official outputs breach turnover, max_names, and 2026-05 Σw constraints and omit DSR/Harvey verification.
rebuttal_required: Regenerate S3 holdings and period returns so every date has Σw=1, including 2026-05 TSMOM exposure.
Fix turnover units/formula and prove Annualized_Turnover <600% from the official Forge metrics table.
Provide explicit global max_names compliance or a signed mandate changing max_names scope before production admission.
Supply CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 Newey-West t-stats plus DSR with consistent candidate penalty for strategy and baseline.
rationalization_red_flags: small N=3 OK but no shrinkage

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Architect PASS_PARTIAL and Forge self-claims cannot offset official Forge hard-constraint breaches; Codex critic should count this as a failed third source until regenerated outputs clear the contract.

walk-forward holdings가 every date Σw=1, max_names<=20, turnover<600%를 공식 output 기준으로 통과하는가?
Lockbox marker 이후 strategy NAV가 visible하고 frozen extension evidence가 있는가?
